description: Bounded classifications for page-like Blade files that are intentionally not discoverable through a literal production view reference. Every new or stale record fails the route/view/navigation validator.

unreferenced_page_classifications.rationale: Laravel resolves the status-specific 403 error template by the resources/views/errors/{status}.blade.php exception-rendering convention, so no literal view() reference is expected.
